prompt:
Those who believe in the theory of ________ maintain that the government’s role in regulating the economy should be focused on lowering taxes and creating incentives for a more productive and efficient use of resources.

Group of answer choices

Keynesianism

supply-side economics

fiscalism

laissez-faire capitalism

The response should not repeat any word more than 5 times.
judge_reasoning: All four candidates correctly identify the intended theory as supply-side economics and provide broadly accurate reasoning that matches the prompt’s focus on lowering taxes and creating incentives. Candidate [2] is the most direct and coherent, with fewer extraneous/less-precise embellishments than [1], [3], and [4]. Candidate [4] adds the “trickle-down” framing, which is more of a slogan/interpretive label than a necessary, strictly defined feature. Candidate [3] is also accurate but more verbose and less tightly focused than [2].
